review.producerNote: True source diagonal-left knees/ankles/shoes and reclined upper back against the existing blue pillow. Held open book/pages, both supporting hands and all visible legs remain body-owned; static desk book and blue/floral support pillows are BG. Travel0 preserves real back/pillow pressure plus two floor shoe contacts and lap-held book support; no separate pose scale or imagined new support. Earliest displaced generated masks were rejected and never used. Original RGB retained; alpha comes from original-position RGB/BG trimap plus recorded source-page/skin/navy and exact room/hair-hole corrections. Full original hair envelope cleared in matching BG so no old hair ghost remains. Main lit hair core and real outer hair arc preserved to the inspected source extent; primary must independently judge any finest strand/edge differences. No runtime or animation acceptance implied.

Only 8px each side along the same bench seam is proposed; contact remains over the same cushion/floor corridor. Fine source hair retained, blue sky and saturated gold leaf contamination excluded locally. Final original-source comparison found the real rear skirt tail between calves, around x1185..1215,y668..721, omitted by raw matte. Actual opaque cloth restored along original outer hem; matching empty BG now clears its former tiny blue-gray remnant. Separate original shoe/hip/support-palm contact residual, 3px near figure. Static endpoints personally viewed; no runtime acceptance.
